svg.title: From synthetic transactions to published evidence
svg.desc: The complete project flow • Batch evaluation, traceable results, tested software and an interactive website. Detailed source mapping is provided in README.md.
svg.text: From synthetic transactions to published evidence
The complete project flow • Batch evaluation, traceable results, tested software and an interactive website
Features retain past history; split filters select fitting rows. Model families were not measured at every dataset scale.
TWO EXECUTION PATHS SUPPORT THIS FLOW
One Azure VM → local Docker build → DuckDB + LightGBM
ADLS source / JSON transfers; Kaggle inputs direct to VM
GitHub Actions → tested Docker image → GHCR
Signed tags promote the same manifest; Pages ships separately
Build, security, release and website paths → diagram 03
Interpretation: synthetic benchmark evidence • Seed, split and leakage diagnostics • Raw data and row-level replay stay private
Research evaluation; no live bank deployment or inference service.
